facts.text: Gill says Warwick the smith displays a superb mithril chain shirt sized for a normal-sized person but always refuses to sell it; Dunk saw it glow in the moonlight, clearly magical. Why won't Warwick sell the mithril shirt?

Warwick keeps adding lucky charms (horseshoes, rabbit feet, clovers) to his shop and home. Ingrid secretly climbs to his window every night to leave gifts and watch him sleep. Is that what Warwick is warding against, and does he know about it?

Ingrid's alchemist shop in Brandonsford sells mandrake root tea that heals all wounds (10 gold), witch powder that glows on anything magical (7 gold) and essence of wolfsbane against wolves (5 gold); the party can buy them there.
Dunk wants to obtain Warwick's magical mithril chain shirt, which he says could help against the dragon.
